faults.detail: edge eF1 n10 (Acquired-Banner Storefront) -> n11 (Oracle EBS GL) tagged shared-db — storefront writes GL journal rows directly into the EBS schema over JDBC, no integration layer
edge eF2 n9 (Top-20 Vendor Direct EDI) -> n1 (Warehouse Management) tagged bypass-api — top-20 vendors land ASN/invoice files straight on the gen2 WMS SFTP, skipping the EDI gateway/integration hub
b1 (Item Master) -> b3 (Pricing) via e2, b3 -> b4 (Promotions & Markdown) via e4, injected eF3 b4 -> b1 'promo flags written back to item master' closes the cycle

injected edge eF4 b3 (Governed Analytics Zone, part 1) -> b1 (PCI CDE Tokenization Zone, part 0) 'intraday direct reads of OLTP payment feeds' — analytics reading OLTP during the day, upward edge across trust bands (parts set 0/0/1/2)
edge eF5 b2 (Gen 1 COBOL WMS — 12 DCs) -> b4 (Gen 3 Microservices Pilot — 23 DCs) tagged cross-version — gen1 CICS programs invoke gen3 pilot inventory APIs directly across WMS generations
b1 (Item Master & Attribution) has 46 members: 5 core subsystems + 41 attribute-domain modules (m1100–m1140, 'Attr domain — Lumber' … 'Attr domain — Storage & Organization')
edge eF7 n2 (SLS0100 Sales Posting) -> n_glx0700; target job GLX0700 (legacy GL extract) was decommissioned in 2024 and the node no longer exists — Control-M condition never cleaned up
